question: Should QQBot gateway receive frames be capped at 1 MiB, or should the channel use a larger protocol-specific bound before this PR is rebased and merged?
rationale: The ws mechanism is correct, but choosing the permanent cap trades resource protection against rejection of unusually large legitimate gateway events, and no official QQ maximum is cited.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Accept the tested 1 MiB plugin-local limit, then rebase while preserving the merged 30-second handshake timeout.

options.title: Choose a larger cap
options.body: Use a larger documented or conservatively evidenced limit, then rerun boundary proof at that value.

options.title: Require production evidence
options.body: Pause until authenticated or captured QQBot gateway traffic establishes a defensible upper bound for legitimate events.

recommendation.title: Approve 1 MiB
recommendation.body: Accept the tested 1 MiB plugin-local limit, then rebase while preserving the merged 30-second handshake timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work on this exact QQBot WebSocket factory makes them the best available owner for coordinating the combined transport contract.
